candidate_program.name: sufficient_exchange_priority
candidate_program.rationale: Prioritizes roots whose reward covers the sum of active rival rewards, then ranks other roots by reward share per conflict. This uses a conservative local exchange condition with no added graph work; its priority jump can affect search order.
candidate_program.rule: 1 + weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / ((1 + degree) * (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
